building_scope: two monitored office floors; not full Building 59

method.cleaning_disclosure: Publisher supplied cleaned/curated files; the release README states gaps/outliers were modified using linear interpolation, KNN and matrix factorization. These results do not represent raw missingness.
method.percentiles: deterministic row-stride samples disclosed per source specification

modeling_constraints.basis: All eight supply/return fan feedback channels are evaluated at >5% by regime and source-clock hour.
modeling_constraints.constraint: Do not model the RTUs as a simple weekday-only on/off schedule without reconciling fan feedback.
modeling_constraints.exclusion: Fan-speed feedback is not a proof of airflow, electric power, or occupancy and may include minimum/override operation.

modeling_constraints.constraint: Use the recorded RTU SAT setpoint distributions as bounded schedule/reset candidates by unit and regime.
modeling_constraints.exclusion: A BAS setpoint is not proof that the coil met it; retain the separate SAT tracking error evidence.

modeling_constraints.constraint: Retain a nonzero zone thermostat deadband and preserve measured zone-to-zone diversity.
modeling_constraints.exclusion: Zero/implausible setpoints and nonpositive deadbands are excluded, not repaired.

modeling_constraints.constraint: Model UFT fan modulation separately from RTU availability; 20% is treated as a candidate minimum, not off.
modeling_constraints.exclusion: The publisher calls these fan speeds, while Brick types them as supply-air-flow sensors; actuator semantics remain unresolved.

modeling_constraints.constraint: Represent terminal hydronic heating operation explicitly and preserve the 2019 heat-pump regime boundary.
modeling_constraints.exclusion: Valve position is not thermal load; frequent 0%/100% saturation requires control-semantics review.

modeling_constraints.constraint: Treat outdoor-air fraction/economizer/static-pressure inputs as measured control priors, not fixed ASHRAE defaults.

outdoor_air_fraction.claim_boundary: Rows with outdoor-air flow <=100 cfm are treated as unavailable/zero, not proof of zero ventilation; publisher metadata limits useful OA-flow availability to Apr-Dec 2020.
outdoor_air_fraction.definition: recorded outdoor-air flow divided by recorded supply-air flow

modeling_constraints.exclusion: The pressure unit is publisher-labeled psi but magnitude/Brick semantics require verification; OA flow is useful only for its disclosed availability window; no economizer-effectiveness claim is made without aligned OAT/MAT/RAT analysis.

outdoor_air_fraction.claim_boundary: Rows with outdoor-air flow <=100 cfm are treated as unavailable/zero, not proof of zero ventilation; publisher metadata limits useful OA-flow availability to Apr-Dec 2020.
outdoor_air_fraction.definition: recorded outdoor-air flow divided by recorded supply-air flow

sat_tracking.definition: measured supply-air temperature minus recorded supply-air temperature setpoint

zone_deadbands.definition: recorded cooling setpoint minus recorded heating setpoint

prohibited_claims: Do not call the observed source-clock hours a local civil-time schedule until timezone/DST is confirmed.
Do not treat cleaned-file completeness as raw sensor completeness.
Do not treat fan speed, valve position, damper position, setpoint or airflow as electric or thermal load.
Do not treat partial south-half occupant counts as whole-office occupancy.
Do not infer installed capacity, COP, envelope properties or tariff assignment from this evidence.

regime_definitions.2019_post_reported_march_change: 2019-04-01 through 2019-12-31; the publication reports a change after March, but the exact commissioning timestamp remains unresolved

time_basis_status: The publisher files do not embed a timezone. Hour-of-day results use the recorded source clock; conversion to America/Los_Angeles is prohibited until the BAS time basis and DST convention are confirmed.
